titleEn: Minimum Size Subarray in Infinite Array
title: 无限数组的最短子数组
summary: 把正整数数组无限重复拼接，求和恰好等于 target 的最短连续子数组长度；不存在时返回负一。
insight: 设单周期总和为 total，可先确定 target 中必然包含的完整周期数 quotient，并只为 remainder 寻找额外片段。余数小于 total，若可表示，其最短片段跨界也只需在两个相邻周期上用正数滑动窗口搜索。
pitfalls: 窗口必须允许跨越周期末尾与开头
target 和周期总和的运算使用 long
余数为零时无需再找窗口
滑动窗口只因元素全为正数而成立

solutions.title: 完整周期与双周期滑动窗口
solutions.idea: 拆出完整周期后在线性长度的双倍数组中寻找余数。
steps: 若 remainder 为零，返回 quotient*n
right 扫描 0..2n-1 并加入 nums[right%n]
找不到返回负一，否则返回 quotient*n+best

code.java: class Solution { public int minSizeSubarray(int[] nums,int target){int n=nums.length;long total=0;for(int value:nums)total+=value;long quotient=target/total,remainder=target%total;if(remainder==0)return (int)(quotient*n);int left=0,best=Integer.MAX_VALUE;long window=0;for(int right=0;right<2*n;right++){window+=nums[right%n];while(window>remainder&&left<=right)window-=nums[left++%n];if(window==remainder)best=Math.min(best,right-left+1);}return best==Integer.MAX_VALUE?-1:(int)(quotient*n+best);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minSizeSubarray(nums:IntArray,target:Int):Int{val n=nums.size;val total=nums.sumOf{it.toLong()};val quotient=target.toLong()/total;val remainder=target.toLong()%total;if(remainder==0L)return (quotient*n).toInt();var left=0;var best=Int.MAX_VALUE;var window=0L;for(right in 0 until 2*n){window+=nums[right%n];while(window>remainder&&left<=right)window-=nums[left++%n];if(window==remainder)best=minOf(best,right-left+1)};return if(best==Int.MAX_VALUE)-1 else (quotient*n+best).toInt()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minSizeSubarray(vector<int>& nums,int target){int n=nums.size();long long total=accumulate(nums.begin(),nums.end(),0LL),quotient=target/total,remainder=target%total;if(remainder==0)return quotient*n;int left=0,best=INT_MAX;long long window=0;for(int right=0;right<2*n;++right){window+=nums[right%n];while(window>remainder&&left<=right)window-=nums[left++%n];if(window==remainder)best=min(best,right-left+1);}return best==INT_MAX?-1:quotient*n+best;} };
